titulo: Conjugate regular verbs in the conditional
subtitulo: Keep the whole infinitive and add -ía: trabajaría, comería, viviría.
regla: Add -ía, -ías, -ía, -íamos, -ían to the whole infinitive. The same endings for -ar, -er and -ir verbs.

bloques.texto: The **conditional** (**condicional simple**) is the _would_ form: **compraría** = _I would buy_. For regular verbs the rule is simple: keep the **whole infinitive** and add the endings.

The endings are the **same for -ar, -er and -ir** verbs, and they're the same as the **imperfect** endings of **-er** and **-ir** verbs (**comía**, **vivía**). The difference is that the conditional keeps the infinitive: **comía** (_I was eating_) vs **comería** (_I would eat_). See [[5264|-er and -ir verbs in the imperfect]].
**Every** form has a written accent on the **í**: **-ía**, **-íamos**... The stress falls on it.
**Yo** and **él, ella, usted** are identical (**comería**), so add the subject if it's not clear from context.
Tip: the conditional is the future dreaming: same infinitive as **comeré**, but it says _I would..._ with a sigh: **comería**.

lista.en: I would buy a longer board.
You would eat more healthily with us.
Beto would sleep better in a hammock.
We would plant corn in the garden.

lista.es: Ustedes nunca ==abrirían== un Tsuru sin permiso del dueño.
lista.en: You would never open a Tsuru without the owner's permission.
Holden would risk everything for his crew.

filas.t: Yo comía más tacos, pero estoy lleno.
Yo comería más tacos, pero estoy lleno.

lista.nota: **Comía** is the imperfect (_I used to eat, I was eating_). _I would eat_ keeps the infinitive: **comería**.
The accent on **í** is in every form, **nosotros** too.

filas.t: Ellos trabajarían mañana, ya lo decidieron.
Ellos trabajarán mañana, ya lo decidieron.

lista.nota: **-án** is the future (_will_); **-ían** is the conditional (_would_).

lista.texto: _Would_: a hypothesis or wish. See [[7431|the conditional for hypothesis, wish or suggestion]].
Polite requests: [[6713|poder in the conditional for polite requests]]. Also [[7059|me gustaría]].
A guess about the past: [[5069|the conditional for probability in the past]].
The future seen from the past: [[7761|the conditional as future in the past]].
The future also keeps the whole infinitive: [[5155|regular verbs in the simple future]].
Irregular verbs use their future stem: [[5064|hacer]], [[5772|tener]], [[5853|poder]], [[5055|querer]] in the conditional.
Same endings, different tense: [[5264|-er and -ir verbs in the imperfect]].
_Should have_: [[5054|deber in the conditional + haber + participle]].

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: Which one means _I would eat_? **comía** or **comería**.
